reason: The finding holds and I reproduced it independently from the local copies of the dummy logs (_dl/*/ *.log, parsed with scratchpad/v27c4.py; no Kaggle API call). Format below is total s / setup before 'GPU shard 0' / after-setup s. exp85a 1388/262/1126 vs exp89s 1566/436/1130. exp89p 1313/253/1060 vs exp89q 1576/519/1057. exp89r 1959/486/1473 vs exp87a 1870/300/1570. ILP sums: exp89p 245.4 = exp89q 245.4; exp85a 257.0 vs exp89s 259.0. I also found why the setup phase varies. The silent gap runs from 'Low-detection dump applied' (~46 s) to 'V1284 head patched'. In that window cell 4 runs `sorted(Path('/kaggle/input').rglob('biohub-v1284-head-s075/v1284_head.pt'))`, a recursive walk of all of /kaggle/input including the competition data trees (experiments/exp89q_k2cap6_k_sec_dis225/*.ipynb cell 4). That is filesystem I/O. It reads no config and runs before prediction and the ILP, so DIS cannot affect it. Non-DIS runs show the same spread: exp70q 746 s, exp85b 640 s, exp75 643 s, exp70a 581 s. The four DIS 2.25 setups all falling above the non-DIS median (~340 s) is chance (p~1/16), since the mechanism cannot see DIS. Two caveats. (1) The card pairs exp88a with exp88b, but exp88b is TAU 0.7, not exp88a's parent. The right parent is exp70g: after-setup 1054 vs 1106 s (+5%), ILP 262 vs 285 s (+9%). That is still inside the non-DIS band of 1,028-1,170 s and far below any deadline, with ILP capped at timeout=1200 s per clip. (2) 'Hidden L of DIS files = parent family' is an inference: no DIS file has ever been read on the hidden test. The dummy evidence (identical ILP time on the K2 pairs) supports it. Value is operational only, with zero LB effect. It fixes a wrong fact (round26 report.json new_facts 6) that CONTEXT has not yet corrected (checked l.3956-3998), and stops DIS from being flagged as a runtime or ins-tail risk in the night and morning timing. It closes no line, adds no kernel change and needs no GPU, so R1-R10 are untouched. This duplicates scan_recheck R27-RC-B, so the two should be merged.
